fields.System.Title: INV-803 — Rebuild balances from the ledger
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer recovering from an incident, I want to regenerate balances from the
movement ledger, so that a corrupted balance table is not a permanent loss of truth.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the movement ledger, when the rebuild runs, then balances are recalculated
  • from it for the requested scope.
  • - Given an uncorrupted database, when the rebuild runs, then every balance is
  • unchanged.
  • - Given the rebuild, then it can be scoped to one product, one location, or everything.
  • - Given the rebuild, then it runs in batches and does not lock the warehouse out.
  • - Given the rebuild, then it produces a report of every balance it changed.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Rebuild disagreeing with normal writes ([doc 08 §5.2](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · invariant · performance |
